mappings.description: Indicates whether the Docker network has been successfully created.

mappings.doc: Status of the network with ID `network_id` on the device. Possible values: [Receive, Missing, Present, Error]

mappings.description: List of subnets defined in the network's IPAM configuration, as reported by Docker.
Number of IP addresses currently in use or reserved within each subnet.
mappings.doc: Each value corresponds to the subnet at the same index in status/ipam/subnets. The values are derived from Docker's network inspection data.

mappings.description: Number of IP addresses available for dynamic allocation within each subnet's IP range.
mappings.doc: Each value corresponds to the subnet at the same index in status/ipam/subnets. The values are derived from Docker's network inspection data.

mappings.description: List of subnets configured in the Docker network's IPAM settings.
mappings.doc: Contains the subnet definitions from the network's IPAM configuration as reported by Docker.

mappings.description: List of IP ranges configured for dynamic address allocation.
mappings.doc: Each value corresponds to the subnet at the same index in ipam/config/subnets. These ranges are obtained from Docker's IPAM configuration.

mappings.description: List of gateway addresses configured for each subnet.
mappings.doc: Each value corresponds to the subnet at the same index in ipam/config/subnets. These gateway addresses are obtained from Docker's IPAM configuration.
